_comment: Neuron Flame remote model catalogue. Fetched by the app on launch + every 24h. Merged with the in-binary fallback list (TranscriptionModelRegistry.predefinedModels). Entries here ADD to or OVERRIDE the local list — they don't replace it. Schema versioned via `version` field; bump it when making breaking changes the client must understand.

models.description: Higher-quality 8-bit quantized variant. Closer to full Large v3 Turbo accuracy at roughly half the size. Good middle ground if Q5 is too aggressive.
HuggingFace's distilled Whisper Large v3. About 6× faster than the original with ~99% relative WER. English-focused. Worth trying on slower Apple Silicon.
Quantized tiny English-only model. Tiny enough to live entirely in cache — useful for very short utterances on older Macs or low-power scenarios.
